title: High-precision real AGM logarithm
objective: Implement and qualify the PARI 2.17.4 logr_abs to logagmr_abs real AGM logarithm path at 153088 bits in ordinary CPython-parseable Python using packed arithmetic and bounded reused storage

oracles: Pristine PARI 2.17.4 packed triples across cutoff and representative positive inputs

handoff.summary: Translated and qualified PARI 2.17.4's 153088-bit real AGM logarithm and full high-precision real dispatch in ordinary Python. Seven packed triples match pristine PARI exactly, including both sides of the dispatch cutoff and one authentic field-3 root; CPython, JavaScript, and GMP source paths agree on the representative case.
risks: The gate is intentionally fixed to 153088 bits and Linux is the measured native platform.
Complex AGM logarithms and arbitrary field-3 complex embeddings remain unimplemented.
next_steps: Integrate the real logarithm into the field-3 relation-log replay for the remaining real embedding columns.
Implement the separately bounded logagmcx/agm1cx cut described in the audit before admitting complex relation logs.
